functions.name: SHA-256

description.short: Cryptographic hash function producing a 256-bit digest.
description.full: SHA-256 is a member of the SHA-2 family. It processes input in 512-bit blocks and outputs a 256-bit hash.

vulnerabilities: Length extension attack when used in raw form for MAC constructions. Use HMAC-SHA256 instead.
Not resistant to quantum attacks; Grover's algorithm reduces security to 128 bits.
